articles.title: American Healthcare REIT Acquires Eight Seniors Housing Communities for $696M
articles.summary: IRVINE, CALIF. — American Healthcare REIT Inc. (NYSE: AHR) has acquired eight senior housing communities in six states for $696 million. The properties, which collectively comprise 867 units and were built between 2020 and 2022, are located in Massachusetts, Connecticut, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware and Georgia. articles.title: Burlington Stores is moving its headquarters to Philadelphia
articles.summary: The discount retailer, long based in South Jersey, plans to invest $370 million in the move, and use another $30 million in Pa. grants. It will eventually relocate 1,500 employees and hire 500.

articles.title: Chobani Agrees to Buy Former Keurig Dr Pepper Manufacturing Facility in Allentown, Pennsylvania for $125M
articles.summary: ALLENTOWN, PA. — Chobani has entered into an agreement to acquire the former manufacturing facility of Keurig Dr Pepper in the Lehigh Valley city of Allentown, including the lease, equipment and operations and related infrastructure, for $125 million. Keurig Dr Pepper first opened the 1.5 million-square-foot facility in 2021, and the announcement coincides with Keurig Dr Pepper agreeing to sell its full equity stake in Chobani back to the company for $800 million. articles.title: NFIB reports healthy small business job market
articles.summary: The NFIB reports a healthy small business job market in Pennsylvania with 35% of owners reporting unfilled job openings in august, above the historical average.

articles.title: Geisinger’s new cancer center features advanced radiation technology
articles.summary: LEWISBURG — Geisinger’s $32 million cancer center in East Buffalo Township is home to a radiation treatment machine that a specialist describes as a “workhorse in radiation oncology.”

articles.title: Sunbury modular home builder serves Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, more
